tenderSchedule.title: Selection of Manpwer Agency for Providing Manpower Services on Outsouced Basis for the Office of Senior Geologist, Mine and Geology Udupi.
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of Manpwer Agency for Providing Manpower Services on Outsouced Basis for the Office of Senior Geologist, Mine and Geology Udupi.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
IMPORTANT NOTE: The Service Charge less than 3% will be rejected.
Remaining all other terms and conditions are as per attached Tender Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should furnish all Technical Documents as mentioned in the Tender Document.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Attested copies of the documents showing that the firm had an average financial turnover during the last 3 years i.e. Attested copies of the documents showing that the firm had an average financial turnover during the last 3 years i.e. 2021-22 & 2022-23 and 2023-24 of Rs. 1.00 Crore Audit Statement and Turnover certificate from the Charted Accountant of Rs. 1.00 Crore Audit Statement and Turnover certificate from the Charted Accountant
Copy of the EPF code number obtained from EPF department and attested copy of paid challan copies for last 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
Copy of the ESI code number obtained from ESI department and paid challan copies for last 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
GST Registration certitficate and GST paid challan copies for last 3 years i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
PAN Number certitficate and attested copies of Income Tax Returns Last 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
Registration certificate with the Labour Department -Regulation and Abolition Act 1970
Self-declaration on a Rs. 100/- bond paper for not being black listed by any Government/Semi-Government institution or private enterprises and Non Elected Member.
Statement of past performance of at least 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 in supply of outsource Man power service to Government/Semi-Government institution.
The Tenderer shall be either a company, firm, Individual proprietorship, Non-Governmental Organization who are registered under Law, Cooperative societies who are registered under society Act.

The Tenderer should furnish Bankers Cheque of Rs. 25.00 Lakhs from any Nationalized Bank in the favour of Senior Geologist, Dept of Mines & Geology, Udupi District and submit in the FORM NO 9 of the Tender document.
Work done certificate of similar nature of work executed in the Last 3 years i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
